title: A 97-year-old Bronx movie palace is becoming NYC’s 2nd-largest theater after surviving fire and closure
summary_full: By 2026, the Bronx's Loewe's Paradise Theatre will be reborn as a vibrant Performing Arts Centre, promising to uplift community engagement. Meticulous restoration will celebrate the theater's rich heritage while enhancing both inside and outside spaces. This impressive 4,000-seat venue will host a diverse array of performances and community programs, featuring a rooftop outdoor stage and a gourmet restaurant, aiming to inspire youth and promote cultural connection among residents.
